subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After requester wake succeeds, should missing required visible message-tool delivery become terminally failed, or remain bounded and retryable?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes the completion contract, and source/tests cannot determine whether permanent visible-output failure or continued retry is the intended product behavior.

options.title: Preserve bounded retries
options.body: Credit requester wake separately while keeping required visible delivery pending until it succeeds or reaches an explicit retry limit.

options.title: Adopt terminal split
options.body: Accept requester wake as final and record required visible output as terminally failed without further automatic delivery attempts.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Retain current behavior until the broader subagent delivery state machine has a single owner-approved contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded retries
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake separately while keeping required visible delivery pending until it succeeds or reaches an explicit retry limit.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged deterministic announcement work defines the closest existing parent-wake, retry, and lifecycle behavior.
